## IInspectionExternalProperties interface

One entry of the log's `inlineExternalProperties`<!-- -->, shown verbatim.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface IInspectionExternalProperties 
```

## Remarks

Results embedded here are counted and shown as written rather than merged into run findings. Any declared runGuid association stays in that verbatim content. External property files referenced by a run are never fetched; those references stay in the run's `otherContent` with a warning.
